topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I should have known better, but I dug around anyway. The earth here is damp and forgiving, making the process almost peaceful. That is, until my shovel hit something solid, unyielding. A box, or so it seemed. It wasn’t just any box, though; it was weathered, sealed tightly, and etched with symbols I couldn’t quite place. I wiped the dirt away, revealing a date from decades past. My hands trembled as I lifted the lid, the contents cloaked in shadow. Whatever lies inside, it feels as though I’m not meant to see it, as if the secrets within are better left undisturbed. But now, the past has caught up with me, and I’m not sure how to let it go.
